summary: Preserve the current Tella framework and published workflows; implement browser-free lesson planning, editing, review and delivery.
reason: The current generator emits scaffolds for existing novel commands and has context-aware clients, scoped storage, a new error-writer signature, and runtime MCP mirroring. Preserve actual workflow bodies, snapshot and divergence protections, transcript FTS data, uncached exports and credential probes, current transcript routes, all source media kinds, and old flags while keeping generated endpoints, validation, output envelopes and transport security. Preserve the original creator and release ledger. Compose official lesson workflows using existing cut safety and shared HTTP helpers. Retire cookie mistake transport; preserve creator, contributor alignment and release ledger. Keep capability descriptions aligned with source-only upload, storyboard export versus apply, term-matched cuts versus replacement media, saved-snapshot undo versus inline restore, and separate webhook tail/replay commands; use concrete safe documentation examples and scoped acceptance evidence.
validated_outcome: Offline HTTP fixtures exercise official request bodies, preview URL preservation, apply/dry-run/refusal safety, fresh playback chapters, strict YAML, saved retake divergence, source insertion order, raw caption bytes, encoded export polling, real artifact writes and credential isolation. Full tests/vet/build and local binary help are required for T2 completion. Live Tella acceptance remains unverified in this coding task; no shipcheck, live mutation, install, stage, commit, push or PR.
contracts: videos preview preserves the complete returned bearer URL including fragment, expiresAt and 24-hour TTL; dry-run never POSTs.

videos auto plans actual timeline clips by default, requires --apply, saves pre-write cut and editor reference state, preserves existing zooms with replaceExisting:false, uses official auto crop/filler/silence APIs, refuses unsupported --layouts before writes, stops on errors and ends successful apply in a preview.

Cut snapshots provide divergence-protected cut-only undo with exclusive editing confirmation. Non-cut reference snapshots never pretend to restore editor history or roll back crop/zoom/style/media effects.

lessons pass strictly parses and validates one YAML recipe before writes, defaults to filler/natural-silence cleanup while preserving style, inserts only existing source references, re-reads edited timing, shows conservative retake plans, applies optional subtitles/fonts/music, drafts bounded chapters in cumulative playback seconds, sets a meaningful frame thumbnail and stops after preview.

lessons ship separately checks the video, exports once per logical request identity, polls uncached status by fully encoded export ID under bounded deadlines, validates actual MP4 and SRT/VTT bytes, writes private atomic files without implicit overwrite, cleans temporary files and prints only successful local paths. CDN downloads carry no API auth and cannot redirect off origin.

find-retakes uses official sentence indices and playback times, only adjacent exact normalized prefixes with at least five words and <=4s proximity, retains the last take and applies only a saved plan matching current transcript/cuts/scope/candidates under cut snapshots. It makes no semantic correctness claim.

Every old find-mistakes path refuses before HTTP/cookie access, including bulk edit-pass and clean flags. Public cleanup and existing transcript/search/export/upload/storyboard/rollback features remain.

agent-chats start requires explicit true --yes (not --agent defaults), deliberate existing target or --new-video, uncached credits before/after and positive balance; verifier/dogfood mutation runs refuse. Thin execute refuses agent start after its dry-preview branch; runtime MCP mirror forwards only boolean yes:true.

storyboard-image fetches video/clip/source JSON storyboard metadata and downloads actual validated WebP bytes atomically; source uses /v1/sources/{id}/storyboard; compact terminal timeline retains JSON/include/clip-ids and the old declarative storyboard/apply-storyboard commands.

Shared client creates a fresh UUID Idempotency-Key once per logical POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, reuses it across retries and respects explicit overrides; reads and presigned CDN uploads receive no generated key.
Runtime MCP mirrors all new workflows, retains confirmation semantics and restricts lesson file parameters to plain artifact basenames under the server's tella-artifacts directory.
Keep Greg Ceccarelli as permanent creator, Cathryn Lavery as existing contributor on all three attribution surfaces, and leave release ledger/version/registry/generated skill mirrors unchanged.

Parent review hardening: canonical nonempty request keys across all case/empty aliases without caller-map mutation; no apply success on empty clips; exact timeline video identity and required nonnegative ordered timelineStartMs offsets; actual max+1 recipe EOF limit; exact duplicate-free reviewed retake subsets; source-only storyboard requests; case-insensitive failed export refusal; MIME parameters and explicit global CDN timeouts with unchanged signatures/credential guards.

Register uniquely owned novel groups and children directly with Cobra AddCommand while retaining collision handling for shared extensions; preserve every runtime path, including both clips find-retakes and videos clips find-retakes. File-level data-source declarations describe actual API/local dependencies without forcing a mixed file into one runtime mode. Archive envelope pagination stays in its shared extraction path.

Only genuinely plan-by-default videos auto, lessons pass and clips find-retakes advertise preview happy paths. Their first examples and happy arguments must not save files, apply edits or confirm writes; audit advertises read-only only while its full path uses GET requests. Actual preview creation, shipping and storyboard image downloads remain mutating surfaces.

Declare timeline/storyboard Use, args and existing flags directly in their registered Cobra constructors, preserving runtime paths, MCP inputs and human timeline output. Register the unique sources upload-file child directly. Keep all 21 research features and the 16 retained feature contracts; exports wait repeats --video, and clip captions/transcript-diff take one clip operand plus --video. Use --video=ID in docs to avoid the unrelated import command boolean flag ambiguity.

Retire unused SessionCookie config ingestion, storage and environment override after cookie transport retirement; ignore old cookie settings, discard them on save and retain public bearer API key and OAuth persistence. Only workflowOffline (harness plus --dry-run) may skip external input validation for apply-storyboard, add-broll, cut-words and storyboard-image; emit concrete workflow intent before client creation, file inspection, uploads or writes. Ordinary dry-run and harness execution retain required-input failures.

Keep the original published CLI version declaration in internal/cli/root.go with its exact release-ledger value; version.go defines only the version command. Both canonical live-preview POST and videos preview create links and must be annotated mcp:read-only=false; read-only MCP must expose neither creating-preview command. The agent guide uses concrete examples, preserves explicit paid consent and directs published repairs here with patch records.

videos clips add-zoom waives only absent scale under workflowOffline (trusted verify/dogfood plus --dry-run), with both IDs present, no explicit --scale and no --stdin. Emit an honest intent requiring scale before client creation or HTTP; never invent a scale, positional failure or mutation success. Ordinary calls and dry runs still require scale; explicit and stdin scales retain numeric 1..3.5 inclusive validation, including NaN/type rejection, and malformed stdin still fails. Preserve valid legacy focus-point payloads.
tella_link_creation_contract: Tella-specific POST videos.live-preview.get-link and videos.recording-link.get mint links: both registry entries require NeedsConfirm=true. Thin tella_read refuses both, tella_execute previews without confirm and POSTs only with boolean confirm:true, and read-only MCP refuses both paths before HTTP. Recording-link and live-preview Cobra commands are mcp:read-only=false, including selection for any future endpoint mirror mode; endpoint mirrors are currently hidden. Preserve the explicit paid agent-chat guard and all parameter/origin/auth guards.
upstream_template_note: Preserve these endpoint facts on Tella reprints; get/get-link operation names do not imply read-only link creation. This is a Tella-specific contract, not a blanket POST rule: genuinely read-only POST search queries must retain generic support. The pinned Press host-check false positive is fixed by 483767eb; use a Press that includes that fix and retain real endpoint metadata.

contracts: Learning-disabled teach, teach-playbook and playbook amend emit disabled:true in JSON/agent mode, retain explicit quiet/human silence, and honor dry-run before disabled learning without creating a store.
Tail dry-run performs no HTTP; single-poll JSON preserves the response envelope and output filtering; streaming events use the Cobra output writer and retain existing interval and harness guards.
Preserve silence-map as a read-only GET composition of clip silences, uncut transcript and source metadata; it returns source metadata, not waveform samples.
Keep existing lessons and workspace MCP tools: pp:parent-group would remove both public tools. Preserve all 288 CLI paths, 73 ordinary MCP tools and their input schemas.

Retain implemented novel bodies and tests, client profile dry-run safeguards, Darwin TLS trust classification, permanent attribution and exact release ledger/runtime versions; refresh MCP descriptions and advertise all 21 novel contracts in tools-manifest.json.
generator_refresh.verification: Focused refresh tests, full go test -count=1 ./..., go vet ./..., go build ./..., rebuilt CLI/MCP runtime discovery and local fixture checks are required.

main_reconciliation.release: Public preparation preserves target release manifest and changelog unchanged and CLI runtime 2026.9.2; source release stamps are not imported.
main_reconciliation.behavior: Retain PR11 list-envelope purge and empty offline lists in shared context-aware sync; use secure serialized transactional DeleteContext with composite resource FTS identity; preserve all main matrix tests with current signatures and output streams.
